item.title: Sinaloa Cartel operative in southeastern Mexico extradited to the US
item.description: Roberto Nájera Gutiérrez, alias “La Gallina,” was extradited on January 7, 2026, from the State Social Reintegration Center No. 14, “El Amate,” in Cintalapa, Chiapas, to the United States, where he is wanted by a Federal Court in Georgia for the crimes of criminal conspiracy and cocaine trafficking. item.title: The New York Times says the “U.S. Pressures Mexico to Allow Forces to Combat Cartels”
item.description: US officials seek to have CIA or Special Operations officers accompany the Mexican military in raids against fentanyl labs. item.title: ARHE Group donates land and equipment to the Mexican Navy in Mazatlán
item.description: To help strengthen operational security capabilities, Grupo ARHE donated equipment to the Mexican Navy (SEMAR) this Thursday in Mazatlán.
